basic_info.description: Great opportunity to own 2 houses on one lot with 2 separate addresses.  653 COMMERCIAL AVE is a newly remodeled 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths, living room/dining combined and kitchen.  656 FIRST LANE is a two-story, 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, living/dining upstairs; 1 bedroom, 1 bath, kitchen and dining area downstairs, 3-car garage. Built in 1998 with approximately 1,830 sq ft.
